 Bryce James' Box Score Stats, Highlights from Arizona's Win vs. Northern Arizona
 Zach Bachar Nov 10, 2026 Bryce James made his third appearance of the 2026-27 season during Arizona's 90-59 win over Northern Arizona on Tuesday night.
 James, the son of Philadelphia 76ers star LeBron James, played 13 minutes in the blowout victory.

 Bleacher Report 21h Arizona didn't face much resistance during the contest, jumping out to a 23-9 lead to open the game. 
 The Wildcats excelled on both ends of the floor throughout the first half, holding a 46-22 edge at halftime.
 Northern Arizona started to cut into the deficit by beginning the second half on an 18-11 run, but Arizona quickly responded with an 18-3 run of its own to gain a 32-point advantage.
 The younger James was previously held scoreless across six minutes in his season debut on Nov. 2, but scored five points and picked up two steals while shooting 2-of-5 from the field during Arizona's 104-84 victory over Cal Poly on Thursday.
 The 19-year-old previously spent the 2025-26 season with the Wildcats, but chose to redshirt as a freshman before entering their rotation this year.
 James will be back in action when Arizona travels to face Auburn on Friday. Tip-off is at 9 p.m. ET.
